==Description==
The '''Necromancer 2''' was a summoner enemy that summoned three [[Strong]]s. It was a stronger version of the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]], as it had higher health and summoned stronger enemies. It was slower than most enemies that debuted alongside it, such as the [[Slow Boss]], meaning that these enemies could easily overtake the '''Necromancer 2''' as it was slower.

The '''Necromancer 2''' was replaced by the [[Summoner Boss]] after the MEGA Update.

==Appearance==
The '''Necromancer 2''' had green skin, a crown, black skull shoulder-pads, diamond-plated armbands, black legs and wore a black robe across its torso. The '''Necromancer 2''' carried a staff which was used to spawn [[Strong]]s.

==Strategy==
*If not prepared, this is quite a big threat.
**If the '''Necromancer 2''' is allowed to spawn hordes of [[Strong]]s, you can be easily overwhelmed with the volume of enemies.
*** Try to have most of your towers at the start to prevent the '''Necromancer 2''' summoning lots of these enemies.
*The [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] is recommended to kill the hordes of '''Necromancer 2s''', as well as wiping out the hordes of [[Strong]]s.
*Most towers struggle to kill the '''Necromancer 2'''.
**High damage towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]], should be set to ''Strongest'' to kill the '''Necromancer 2''' instead of the [[Strong]]s that spawn.

==Trivia==
*This enemy was replaced by the [[Summoner Boss]].
**However, it may also be considered the previous incarnation of the [[Dark Necromancer]], as that can be considered the "second [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]".
*The '''Necromancer 2''' used to spawn [[Blighted (Legacy)|Blighted]]s instead of [[Strong]]s. This was changed as this made the game considerably harder. 
**In a leak it was shown that the '''Necromancer 2''' was originally meant to spawn [[Boomer 1]]s, this however never happened in the game.
**At some corners, some of the [[Blighted (Legacy)|Blighted]]s would suddenly stop moving if the '''Necromancer 2''' was killed.
*The skull shoulder pads used by the '''Necromancer 2''' are the {{RLinkC|4765718|The Riddling Skull}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The staff held by  the '''Necromancer 2''' is the {{RLinkC|26421972|Zombie Staff}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
